about.title: About me
about.header_intro: A journey from MS-DOS commands and the drums, through chemical engineering, to software engineering.
about.1_parag: From a young age, everything to do with computers fascinated me. The family's first computer ran Windows 3.1 and booted straight into DOS — we had to learn the commands just to reach the graphical interface. That early exposure helped me understand what was really going on behind the desktop. It was also where I first lost myself in classics like 'The Incredible Machine', 'Age of Empires', and 'Where in the World is Carmen Sandiego', among others.
about.2_parag: By the time I reached high school, the world of computers had become far more accessible — and it happened to coincide with the explosive growth of the video game industry. I offered no resistance.
about.3_parag: Around that time I also picked up one of my greatest hobbies: the drums. I played in a few garage bands with friends purely for fun, until university arrived and I gradually drifted away from the two worlds that had captivated me: music and computing.
about.4_parag: Far from making my life harder, university introduced me to something I never expected to love. I began studying what has defined me for years now: chemical engineering. Like most students in Córdoba, 'I took my time to graduate — to really absorb everything properly' (pfff, sometimes I like to lie to myself). I eventually got to work in my field, even if I didn't always get it right on the first try. That journey taught me that perseverance is the best companion you can have.
about.x4_parag: Come on, keep trusting NFTs — you'll be rich someday
about.5_parag: While working through my degree, I had the chance to keep exploring the video game industry — until I stumbled upon what I consider the
about.51_parag: (in my humble opinion) of gaming worldwide,
about.x5_parag: I could spend days talking about everything this game has to offer. But this work of art taught me something beyond the fun: that you can go far without needing to be the most competitive, the most skilled, or the smartest. Just like in real life. People who reach their goals do so because they never give up. The extraordinary few are just that — few. The rest of us have to put in the work, but we'll get there. I'm sure of it.
about.6_parag: All of this long-winded introduction leads me to the present day and the reason this project exists: once again I took matters into my own hands and gave myself the time to learn the tools of tomorrow — programming. I started with approachable technologies like Angular, Java, and MySQL. Later I completed a course in PHP and another in .NET with WPF.
about.6b_parag: Being the self-taught person I am, I didn't stop there. I immersed myself in .NET MAUI, building internal projects at the company where I work to make our daily workflows a little easier — what I like to call quality of life tools.
about.7_parag: Now I wait to see what the future holds, since none of the chapters are closed just yet.
about.8_parag: So here's to you, dear reader, for making it this far.

home.pillars_desc: Combining the analytical rigor of engineering with modern software development.
home.ing_sub: Chemical engineer, IT enthusiast and musician by choice.
home.ing_parag: Chemical Engineer with a double degree from the Universidad Nacional de Córdoba and the Università degli Studi di Salerno (2017). I have a strong technical background, including consultancy in renewable energy and biofuels for the Government of the Province of Córdoba, as well as experience as a chemical laboratory technician (E-Chem) and metallographic technician (DBM Materialia / MATRES SRL). Trained in Quality Management Systems and team leadership, I apply an analytical and problem-solving approach to complex technical environments.
home.dev_parag: After completing my FullStack training in 2022 (Angular, React, Java, and .NET), I specialized in C# and MAUI by developing applications for process optimization. Since 2023, I have been working as a Junior Software Engineer, combining specialized client support with development and optimization on SQL Server. In this context, I have implemented tools for centralized client and server management, significantly improving the team's operational efficiency.
home.mus_parag: I've been playing drums since I was 15. During 2019 and 2020 I was part of Xilphide, a Symphonic Metal band influenced by Nightwish, Stratovarius and Epica, among others. With a published album and live performances in Córdoba city.
home.tech_desc: Tools and technologies used in production and personal projects.
home.angul_parag: An open-source, Google-maintained, TypeScript-developed web application framework used to create and manage single-page web applications.
home.java_parag: JAVA is the foundation for virtually all types of network applications, as well as the global standard for developing and deploying mobile and embedded applications, games, web-based content, and enterprise software.
home.php_parag: PHP (recursive acronym PHP: Hypertext Preprocessor) is a very popular open source language that is particularly suitable for web development and can be embedded in HTML.
home.net_parag: .NET (pronounced as 'dot net'; formerly named .NET Core) is a free and open-source, managed computer software framework for Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems. It is a cross-platform successor to .NET Framework. The project is mainly developed by Microsoft employees by way of the .NET Foundation, and released under an MIT License.

projects.title: Projects
projects.header_intro: A curated selection of featured projects in fullstack web development, cross-platform apps with .NET MAUI, and optimization tools.
projects.calc_parag: Classic scientific calculator, with the most important functions.
projects.task_parag: Developed with Angular 14, this project is a task list that allows you to add, delete and edit tasks. Regardless of which page you are on, the information is stored in the browser's IndexedDB.
projects.log_parag: Save your travel memories, use it as a diary or as a reminder of your travels. This project was developed with Angular 14, MySQL and Java.
projects.micro_parag: A small program to calculate and plot microhardness data - Only usable with microhardness CSV file from FutureTech microhardness tester. For a sample to test the program, please contact me.
projects.no_country_parag: Work environment simulation platform. My project was an inventory management page for entrepreneurs and micro businesses. Particularly I was one of the backend developers with JAVA-Springboot, in charge of security with Spring Security and user authentication with JWT. I also collaborated in the deployment of the project and participated as DevOps using Docker.
projects.bmpresence_parag: Complete ecosystem of applications for managing reservations and presences in organizations. Includes a responsive web dashboard with interactive calendar and role-based user management, a REST API backend with JWT stateless authentication, and a .NET MAUI cross-platform mobile/desktop client with offline support.
projects.rdpgenerator_parag: Windows desktop application (v6.2.2) for IT teams to create, organize and deploy remote connection configurations (RDP, AnyDesk, RustDesk). Features include system tray integration, daily log rotation, multi-team support, active connection detection, and integrated PDF documentation viewer with local SQLite database.
projects.secretcard_parag: Real-time multiplayer card game for two players over the network. Built with .NET MAUI for iOS with Firebase Realtime Database for synchronization. Features room system by code, live game history, and four card types (Normal, Blocker, Nullifier, Protector) with reactive MVVM architecture.
projects.rdpissues_parag: Companion application for RDPGenerator that allows IT teams to report technical issues directly from the remote connection management environment. Includes automatic context of user and client information for seamless incident tracking.
projects.onsalesbackend_parag: WPF desktop application in active development that serves as the local administration panel for the OnSales system. Built with C#, XAML and .NET technologies for robust business process management.
